1→{
     2→  "task_description": "# Complete Trakt Integration

Finish the Trakt watchlist status checks and ensure bidirectional sync for watch progress, ratings, and collections. Fix the TODO items in AppleTVHero.tsx and ensure Trakt status indicators appear throughout the UI.

## Rationale
Trakt integration is a key differentiator against Stremio (which lacks native Trakt) and Kodi (which has no cloud sync). Power users specifically choose apps based on Trakt support for cross-device progress tracking. This addresses the known gap in the codebase and competitor pain points pain-1-4 and pain-5-5.

## User Stories
- As a power user, I want my watch progress to sync to Trakt automatically so that I can continue watching on any device
- As a Trakt user, I want to see my watchlist status on content cards so that I know what I've already added
- As a media enthusiast, I want to rate content directly in Nuvio so that my Trakt profile stays updated

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Trakt watchlist status indicators show on all content cards and detail pages
- [ ] Watch progress syncs to Trakt within 30 seconds of playback events
- [ ] Users can add/remove items from Trakt watchlist directly from the app
- [ ] Trakt ratings can be set from the media detail screen
- [ ] Collection sync works bidirectionally with user's Trakt account
- [ ] TODO comments in AppleTVHero.tsx are resolved
",

    83→## Patterns to Follow

    85→### Trakt API Service Pattern
    86→
    87→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
    88→
    89→**Key Points:**
    90→- Singleton pattern: Always use `traktService.getInstance()` for service access
    91→- Native fetch API (no external HTTP libraries)

    98→**Example API Call Pattern:**

   102→    method: 'POST',
   103→    body: JSON.stringify({ movies: items.filter(i => i.type === 'movie'), shows: items.filter(i => i.type === 'show') })
   104→  });
   105→}
   106→```

   108→### Cached Data Access Pattern
   109→
   110→From `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx`:
   111→
   112→**Key Points:**
   113→- Use context for read-heavy operations (status checks)
   114→- Direct service calls for write operations (add/remove/rate)
   115→- Optimistic UI updates: Update UI immediately, sync in background
   116→- Context provides: `isInWatchlist()`, `isInCollection()`, `watchlist`, `collections`, `ratings`
   117→
   118→**Example Usage:**

   120→const { isInWatchlist, addToWatchlist } = useTraktContext();

   128→  await traktService.addToWatchlist([{ type: 'movie', ids: { imdb: imdbId } }]);
   129→  // Context will refresh automatically
   130→};
   131→```
   132→
   133→### Scrobble Pattern (Already Working)
   134→
   135→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
   136→
   137→**Key Points:**
   138→- Scrobble on playback start: `startWatching(content, progress)`
   139→- Progress updates every 5 seconds (debounced)
   140→- Pause handling: `pauseWatching()` if progress <80%
   141→- Complete handling: `stopWatching()` if progress ≥80%
   142→- 46-minute duplicate prevention window
   143→
   144→**Note**: This pattern is already functional - watch progress sync meets the <30-second requirement.
   145→
   146→## Requirements
   147→
   148→### Functional Requirements
   149→
   150→1. **Watchlist Status Indicators**
   151→   - Description: Display visual badges on all content cards and detail pages showing if item is in user's Trakt watchlist or collections
   152→   - Acceptance: User can see at a glance which content is already tracked without opening detail pages
   153→
   154→2. **Watchlist Management**
   155→   - Description: Add/remove content from Trakt watchlist directly within Nuvio UI
   156→   - Acceptance: Buttons/icons on content cards and detail pages trigger immediate Trakt sync with optimistic UI updates
   157→
   158→3. **Rating System**
   159→   - Description: Allow users to rate content (1-10 scale) from media detail screens with ratings syncing to Trakt profile
   160→   - Acceptance: Rating UI appears on detail screens, accepts 1-10 input, displays current rating if exists, syncs to Trakt API
   161→
   162→4. **Watch Progress Sync**
   163→   - Description: Automatically sync playback progress to Trakt during video playback
   164→   - Acceptance: Progress updates reach Trakt within 30 seconds of playback events (start/pause/stop), viewable on Trakt.tv

## Summary: Subtask 6.1 Completed ✅

**Task:** Verify ContentItem badges work correctly

### What Was Found

During verification, I discovered a **bug** in the existing badge implementation:

- The `item.type` from `StreamingContent` is either `'movie'` or `'series'`
- But the Trakt API functions (`isInWatchlist`, `isInCollection`) expect `'movie'` or `'show'`
- The original code used TypeScript cast `as 'movie' | 'show'` which **does not convert the value at runtime**
- This meant badges for TV shows would **never display** because the lookup key `series:tt123` wouldn't match the stored key `show:tt123`

### Fix Applied

Changed type conversion from TypeScript cast to proper runtime conversion:

**Before:**
```typescript
isInWatchlist(item.id, item.type as 'movie' | 'show')
```

**After:**
```typescript
isInWatchlist(item.id, item.type === 'movie' ? 'movie' : 'show')
```

### Changes Made

1. **Badge display conditions** (lines 358, 363) - Fixed to properly convert `'series'` to `'show'`
2. **Menu action handlers** - Fixed `trakt-watchlist` and `trakt-collection` cases with proper type conversion

### Commit

- ✅ Watchlist badge (`playlist-add-check` icon, red) displays when authenticated and item is in watchlist

- ✅ Both badges position correctly (watchlist: top-right, collection: 32px to the left)
- ✅ Follows existing patterns from AppleTVHero.tsx type conversion
- ✅ No debugging statements added
- ✅ Clean commit with descriptive message

[{'type': 'text', 'text': '## Codebase Discoveries
- `src/services/traktService.ts`: Added getUserRating method at line 2975 that fetches ratings via getRatings API and finds the specific item's rating. Uses TraktRatingItem type to access movie?.ids or show?.ids for IMDb matching. Returns the rating (1-10) or null if not found.
- `src/components/home/AppleTVHero.tsx`: handleSaveAction function (line ~572) now properly wired to Trakt watchlist API. Uses addToWatchlist/removeFromWatchlist from TraktContext with optimistic UI updates, error rollback, and type conversion ('series' to 'show'). Toast notifications via showTraktSaved/showTraktRemoved.
- `src/components/home/ContentItem.tsx`: ContentItem now displays rating badges at bottom-left for items the user has rated on Trakt. Uses getUserRating from TraktContext, shows gold star with rating number (1-10). Badge positioned at bottom:6, left:6 to avoid conflict with watchlist/collection badges at top-right.
- `src/hooks/useTraktIntegration.ts`: Added getUserRating callback at line ~367 that looks up ratings from cached ratedContent state. Uses IMDb ID normalization pattern (ensures 'tt' prefix), finds matching rating item by type (movie/show), and returns rating (1-10) or null. Exported in return object at line ~786.
- `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx`: TraktContextProps interface now includes rating management methods: addRating(imdbId, type, rating) => Promise<boolean>, removeRating(imdbId, type) => Promise<boolean>, and getUserRating(imdbId, type) => number | null. These methods are passed through from useTraktIntegration hook and available via useTraktContext() throughout the app.
- `src/components/trakt/TraktRatingComponent.tsx`: New TraktRatingComponent created with: 1-10 rating display (5 stars with half-star precision), tap-to-rate functionality, loading states during API calls, error states for failed operations, optimistic UI updates with rollback, responsive sizing for phone/tablet/TV. Uses useTraktContext for getUserRating, addRating, removeRating methods. Exports as default component.
- `src/components/trakt/TraktRatingModal.tsx`: New TraktRatingModal component created for rating content on Trakt. Features: 1-10 rating selector with two rows of 5 buttons each, confirm/cancel/clear action buttons, current rating badge display, loading/error states, responsive sizing for different devices, Trakt brand colors, rating text descriptions (e.g., "Totally Ninja!" for 10). Uses useTraktContext for getUserRating, addRating, removeRating methods. Modal follows same pattern as TrailerModal with dark overlay, rounded container, header with close button.
- `src/components/trakt/index.ts`: Barrel export file for Trakt components. Exports TraktRatingComponent and TraktRatingModal using the pattern `export { default as ComponentName } from './ComponentName'`. This allows clean imports like `import { TraktRatingComponent, TraktRatingModal } from '../components/trakt'` throughout the app.
- `src/screens/MetadataScreen.tsx`: MetadataScreen passes rating-related props to HeroSection via the imdbId prop. HeroSection receives imdbId and passes it to ActionButtons, which passes it to TraktRatingComponent. The TraktRatingComponent internally uses useTraktContext() to access getUserRating, addRating, and removeRating methods - these are NOT passed as direct props but accessed via context.

- `src/services/traktService.ts`: Added getUserRating method at line 2975 that fetches ratings via getRatings API and finds the specific item's rating. Uses TraktRatingItem type to access movie?.ids or show?.ids for IMDb matching. Returns the rating (1-10) or null if not found.
- `src/components/home/AppleTVHero.tsx`: handleSaveAction function (line ~572) now properly wired to Trakt watchlist API. Uses addToWatchlist/removeFromWatchlist from TraktContext with optimistic UI updates, error rollback, and type conversion ('series' to 'show'). Toast notifications via showTraktSaved/showTraktRemoved.
- `src/components/home/ContentItem.tsx`: ContentItem now displays rating badges at bottom-left for items the user has rated on Trakt. Uses getUserRating from TraktContext, shows gold star with rating number (1-10). Badge positioned at bottom:6, left:6 to avoid conflict with watchlist/collection badges at top-right.
- `src/hooks/useTraktIntegration.ts`: Added getUserRating callback at line ~367 that looks up ratings from cached ratedContent state. Uses IMDb ID normalization pattern (ensures 'tt' prefix), finds matching rating item by type (movie/show), and returns rating (1-10) or null. Exported in return object at line ~786.
- `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx`: TraktContextProps interface now includes rating management methods: addRating(imdbId, type, rating) => Promise<boolean>, removeRating(imdbId, type) => Promise<boolean>, and getUserRating(imdbId, type) => number | null. These methods are passed through from useTraktIntegration hook and available via useTraktContext() throughout the app.
- `src/components/trakt/TraktRatingComponent.tsx`: New TraktRatingComponent created with: 1-10 rating display (5 stars with half-star precision), tap-to-rate functionality, loading states during API calls, error states for failed operations, optimistic UI updates with rollback, responsive sizing for phone/tablet/TV. Uses useTraktContext for getUserRating, addRating, removeRating methods. Exports as default component.
- `src/components/trakt/TraktRatingModal.tsx`: New TraktRatingModal component created for rating content on Trakt. Features: 1-10 rating selector with two rows of 5 buttons each, confirm/cancel/clear action buttons, current rating badge display, loading/error states, responsive sizing for different devices, Trakt brand colors, rating text descriptions (e.g., "Totally Ninja!" for 10). Uses useTraktContext for getUserRating, addRating, removeRating methods. Modal follows same pattern as TrailerModal with dark overlay, rounded container, header with close button.
- `src/components/trakt/index.ts`: Barrel export file for Trakt components. Exports TraktRatingComponent and TraktRatingModal using the pattern `export { default as ComponentName } from './ComponentName'`. This allows clean imports like `import { TraktRatingComponent, TraktRatingModal } from '../components/trakt'` throughout the app.
- `src/screens/MetadataScreen.tsx`: MetadataScreen passes rating-related props to HeroSection via the imdbId prop. HeroSection receives imdbId and passes it to ActionButtons, which passes it to TraktRatingComponent. The TraktRatingComponent internally uses useTraktContext() to access getUserRating, addRating, and removeRating methods - these are NOT passed as direct props but accessed via context.
- `.auto-claude/specs/001-complete-trakt-integration/test-verification-7.1-watchlist.md`: Test verification document for Trakt watchlist functionality. Contains 7 test cases covering: add/remove via AppleTVHero and HeroSection, type conversion ('series' to 'show'), optimistic UI updates with rollback, error handling for missing IMDb IDs, and unauthenticated user behavior. Manual verification document pattern for testing React Native components without automated test infrastructure.

# Gotchas & Pitfalls

## [2026-01-10 11:07]
StreamingContent.type is 'movie' or 'series', but Trakt API expects 'movie' or 'show'. TypeScript cast `as 'movie' | 'show'` does NOT convert the value at runtime - use ternary `item.type === 'movie' ? 'movie' : 'show'` instead.

_Context: ContentItem.tsx and any component calling Trakt watchlist/collection/rating functions with StreamingContent items_

     3→## Requirement
     4→Test that watch progress syncs to Trakt within 30 seconds. Existing scrobble system should meet this requirement.
     5→
     6→## Analysis Date
     7→2026-01-10
     8→
     9→## Scrobble System Architecture
    10→
    11→The Trakt watch progress sync is implemented through a sophisticated scrobble system in `src/services/traktService.ts` with the following components:
    12→
    13→### 1. Rate Limiting Queue
    14→- **MIN_API_INTERVAL**: 500ms (reduced for real-time scrobbling)
    15→- Requests are queued and processed sequentially with minimum 500ms between API calls
    16→- Prevents API abuse and 429 rate limiting errors
    17→
    18→### 2. Scrobble Methods
    19→
    20→| Method | Queue Behavior | Deduplication | Use Case |
    21→|--------|---------------|---------------|----------|
    22→| `scrobbleStart()` | Queued | 30s restart prevention | Playback begins |
    23→| `scrobblePause()` | Queued | 100ms | Periodic progress updates |
    24→| `scrobbleStop()` | Queued | 1000ms | Playback ends |
    25→| `scrobblePauseImmediate()` | **Bypasses queue** | 50ms | Critical user actions |
    26→| `scrobbleStopImmediate()` | **Bypasses queue** | 200ms | Critical user actions |
    27→
    28→### 3. Timing Constants (src/services/traktService.ts:585-605)
    29→```typescript
    30→MIN_API_INTERVAL = 500;        // 500ms between API calls
    31→SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS = 5000;       // 5 seconds (reduced from 20s)
    32→STOP_DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000;       // 1 second (reduced from 3s)
    33→SCROBBLE_EXPIRY_MS = 2760000;  // 46 minutes (Trakt's window)
    34→```
    35→
    36→## Timing Verification
    37→
    38→### Worst-Case Scenarios
    39→
    40→| Scenario | Max Timing | Meets <30s? |
    41→|----------|-----------|-------------|
    42→| Immediate scrobble (empty queue) | ~1-3s (network latency) | ✅ YES |
    43→| Queued scrobble (empty queue) | ~1-3s (network latency) | ✅ YES |
    44→| Queued with 5 items ahead | ~3-5s (5 × 500ms + network) | ✅ YES |
    45→| Queued with 20 items ahead | ~12-15s (20 × 500ms + network) | ✅ YES |
    46→| Queued with 50 items ahead | ~27-30s (50 × 500ms + network) | ✅ YES |
    47→
    48→### Realistic Scenarios

    50→| Scenario | Expected Timing | Notes |
    51→|----------|-----------------|-------|
    52→| Start watching (scrobbleStart) | 1-3s | Direct API call after auth check |
    53→| Progress update (scrobblePause) | 1-5s | Queue typically has 0-5 items |
    54→| Stop watching (scrobbleStop) | 1-5s | Queue typically has 0-5 items |
    55→| Immediate pause/stop | <2s | Bypasses queue entirely |
    56→
    57→## Code Evidence
    58→
    59→### 1. Queue Processing (lines 1907-1931)
    60→```typescript
    61→private async processQueue(): Promise<void> {
    62→  while (this.requestQueue.length > 0) {
    63→    const request = this.requestQueue.shift();
    64→    if (request) {
    65→      try {
    66→        await request();
    67→      } catch (error) {
    68→        logger.error('[TraktService] Queue request failed:', error);
    69→      }
    70→      // Wait minimum interval before next request
    71→      if (this.requestQueue.length > 0) {
    72→        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, this.MIN_API_INTERVAL));
    73→      }
    74→    }
    75→  }
    76→}
    77→```
    78→
    79→### 2. Immediate Methods Bypass Queue (lines 2120-2203)
    80→```typescript
    81→// BYPASS QUEUE: Call API directly for immediate response
    82→const result = await this.pauseWatching(contentData, progress);
    83→```
    84→
    85→### 3. Optimized Debouncing (lines 2027-2028)
    86→```typescript
    87→// IMMEDIATE SYNC: Remove debouncing for instant sync, only prevent truly rapid calls (< 100ms)
    88→if (!force && (now - lastSync) < 100) {
    89→  return true; // Skip this sync, but return success
    90→}
    91→```

1→# Specification: Complete Trakt Integration
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This task completes the Trakt.tv integration for Nuvio Streaming TV by wiring up the existing 90%-complete service layer to the UI, implementing bidirectional sync for watch progress, ratings, and collections, and adding visual status indicators throughout the application. The primary focus is resolving TODOs in AppleTVHero.tsx and implementing missing UI features to provide power users with seamless cross-device sync capabilities that differentiate Nuvio from competitors like Stremio (no native Trakt) and Kodi (no cloud sync).
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This task adds new user-facing functionality by completing an existing integration. It involves UI work, service method additions, and end-to-end feature implementation across multiple components, making it a classic feature workflow rather than refactoring, migration, or investigation.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - React Native TypeScript application containing all Trakt integration code
    17→
    18→### This Task Will:
    19→- [x] Fix watchlist status check placeholder in AppleTVHero.tsx (line 571)
    20→- [x] Enable watchlist add/remove functionality in AppleTVHero.tsx (line 610)
    21→- [x] Implement rating methods (add/update/remove) in traktService.ts
    22→- [x] Add rating UI component to media detail screens (1-10 scale)
    23→- [x] Add watchlist/collection status badges to content cards throughout UI
    24→- [x] Verify watch progress sync meets <30-second performance requirement
    25→- [x] Document Trakt API patterns and data flow for future maintenance
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Backend Trakt API development (service layer already complete)
    29→- New Trakt API endpoints beyond watchlist, ratings, collections, and scrobbling
    30→- Trakt social features (comments, lists, recommendations)
    31→- Trakt authentication flow changes (OAuth already implemented)
    32→- Performance optimization beyond meeting the 30-second sync requirement
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### main
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React (React Native with Expo)
    41→- Package Manager: npm
    42→- Key Dependencies: react-native-mmkv (storage), expo-auth-session (OAuth)
    43→- Key Directories:
    44→  - `src/` - Source code
    45→  - `app/` - Application code

    47→

    49→

    53→```

    56→
    57→**Environment Variables Required:**
    58→- `EXPO_PUBLIC_TRAKT_CLIENT_ID` - Trakt API client ID (configured: `1e5e9e33d5a448188d269f1e8a06a213212bf9e5c0dd46c9641fc21d7b9ec1d5`)

    60→- `EXPO_PUBLIC_TRAKT_REDIRECT_URI` - OAuth redirect URI (configured: `nuvio-tv://auth/trakt`)
    61→
    62→## Files to Modify
    63→
    64→| File | Service | What to Change |
    65→|------|---------|---------------|
    66→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` (line 571) | main | Replace `Math.random() > 0.5` placeholder with `traktService.isInWatchlist(imdbId, type)` |
    67→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` (line 610) | main | Uncomment and wire up `addToWatchlist()` / `removeFromWatchlist()` methods |
    68→| `src/services/traktService.ts` | main | Add rating methods: `addRating()`, `updateRating()`, `removeRating()` (currently only GET exists) |
    69→| `components/ContentItem.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add watchlist/collection status badge indicators |
    70→| `components/HeroSection.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add watchlist/collection status badge indicators |
    71→| `app/screens/MediaDetailScreen.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add rating UI component (1-10 scale with star display) |
    72→
    73→## Files to Reference
    74→
    75→These files show patterns to follow:
    76→
    77→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    78→|------|----------------|
    79→| `src/services/traktService.ts` | Trakt API call patterns, rate limiting queue, token management, error handling |
    80→| `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx` | Cached data access pattern for watchlist/collection lookups |
    81→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` | Existing Trakt integration points (TODOs mark incomplete areas) |
    82→
    83→## Patterns to Follow
    84→
    85→### Trakt API Service Pattern
    86→
    87→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
    88→
    89→**Key Points:**
    90→- Singleton pattern: Always use `traktService.getInstance()` for service access
    91→- Native fetch API (no external HTTP libraries)
    92→- Rate limiting: 500ms minimum between requests via internal queue
    93→- Token auto-refresh: Handles expired tokens transparently
    94→- Error handling: Returns structured error objects with status codes
    95→- IMDb ID format: Always include 'tt' prefix (e.g., 'tt1234567')
    96→- Content types: Use 'movie' | 'show' | 'episode' exactly as defined
    97→
    98→**Example API Call Pattern:**
    99→```typescript
   100→async addToWatchlist(items: TraktSyncItem[]): Promise<TraktSyncResponse> {
   101→  return this.makeRequest('/sync/watchlist', {
   102→    method: 'POST',
   103→    body: JSON.stringify({ movies: items.filter(i => i.type === 'movie'), shows: items.filter(i => i.type === 'show') })
   104→  });
   105→}
   106→```
   107→
   108→### Cached Data Access Pattern
   109→
   110→From `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx`:
   111→
   112→**Key Points:**
   113→- Use context for read-heavy operations (status checks)
   114→- Direct service calls for write operations (add/remove/rate)
   115→- Optimistic UI updates: Update UI immediately, sync in background
   116→- Context provides: `isInWatchlist()`, `isInCollection()`, `watchlist`, `collections`, `ratings`
   117→
   118→**Example Usage:**
   119→```typescript
   120→const { isInWatchlist, addToWatchlist } = useTraktContext();
   121→
   122→// Fast cached lookup
   123→const inWatchlist = isInWatchlist(imdbId, 'movie');
   124→
   125→// Write operation with optimistic update
   126→const handleAddToWatchlist = async () => {
   127→  setOptimisticState(true); // Update UI immediately
   128→  await traktService.addToWatchlist([{ type: 'movie', ids: { imdb: imdbId } }]);
   129→  // Context will refresh automatically
   130→};
   131→```
   132→
   133→### Scrobble Pattern (Already Working)
   134→
   135→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
   136→
   137→**Key Points:**
   138→- Scrobble on playback start: `startWatching(content, progress)`
   139→- Progress updates every 5 seconds (debounced)
   140→- Pause handling: `pauseWatching()` if progress <80%
   141→- Complete handling: `stopWatching()` if progress ≥80%
   142→- 46-minute duplicate prevention window
   143→
   144→**Note**: This pattern is already functional - watch progress sync meets the <30-second requirement.
   145→
   146→## Requirements
   147→
   148→### Functional Requirements
   149→
   150→1. **Watchlist Status Indicators**
   151→   - Description: Display visual badges on all content cards and detail pages showing if item is in user's Trakt watchlist or collections
   152→   - Acceptance: User can see at a glance which content is already tracked without opening detail pages
   153→
   154→2. **Watchlist Management**
   155→   - Description: Add/remove content from Trakt watchlist directly within Nuvio UI
   156→   - Acceptance: Buttons/icons on content cards and detail pages trigger immediate Trakt sync with optimistic UI updates
   157→
   158→3. **Rating System**
   159→   - Description: Allow users to rate content (1-10 scale) from media detail screens with ratings syncing to Trakt profile
   160→   - Acceptance: Rating UI appears on detail screens, accepts 1-10 input, displays current rating if exists, syncs to Trakt API
   161→
   162→4. **Watch Progress Sync**
   163→   - Description: Automatically sync playback progress to Trakt during video playback
   164→   - Acceptance: Progress updates reach Trakt within 30 seconds of playback events (start/pause/stop), viewable on Trakt.tv
   165→
   166→5. **Collection Sync**
   167→   - Description: Bidirectional sync of user's Trakt collections
   168→   - Acceptance: Collections from Trakt appear in Nuvio, items added to collections in Nuvio appear on Trakt.tv
   169→
   170→6. **Code Cleanup**
   171→   - Description: Resolve all TODO comments in AppleTVHero.tsx related to Trakt integration
   172→   - Acceptance: No Trakt-related TODO comments remain in AppleTVHero.tsx, placeholder code replaced with functional implementations
   173→
   174→### Edge Cases
   175→
   176→1. **Offline Mode** - Gracefully handle missing network connection; queue Trakt actions and sync when connectivity returns
   177→2. **Token Expiration** - Service automatically refreshes expired tokens; user should never see auth errors during normal usage
   178→3. **Rate Limit Handling** - Respect Trakt API rate limits via internal queue (500ms between requests); prevent 429 errors
   179→4. **Missing IMDb IDs** - Some content may lack IMDb metadata; disable Trakt features gracefully for such items
   180→5. **Episode vs Show Context** - Ensure episode scrobbling correctly links to show in Trakt (requires show IMDb ID + season/episode numbers)
   181→6. **Duplicate Actions** - Prevent double-adding to watchlist or duplicate scrobbles via 46-minute deduplication window
   182→7. **Progress Threshold Edge** - Handle edge case where progress is exactly 80% (should mark as watched per Trakt convention)
   183→
   184→## Implementation Notes
   185→
   186→### DO
   187→- Use `TraktContext.isInWatchlist()` for all read-heavy status checks (faster due to caching)
   188→- Call `traktService` methods directly for write operations (add/remove/rate)
   189→- Implement optimistic UI updates for better perceived performance
   190→- Reuse existing rate limiting queue in traktService - don't create new HTTP clients
   191→- Follow the existing

   *
   * Deletes the user's rating for a movie or show. After removal, the content will no longer

   * - **Rate Limited**: Yes (500ms minimum interval)
   * - **Idempotent**: Yes (removing non-existent rating returns success)
   * - **Response**: `{ deleted: { movies: 1 }, not_found: { movies: 0 } }`

   */
  public async removeRating(imdbId: string, type: 'movie' | 'show'): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      if (!await this.isAuthenticated()) {
        return false;
      }

      // Ensure IMDb ID includes the 'tt' prefix
      const imdbIdWithPrefix = imdbId.startsWith('tt') ? imdbId : `tt${imdbId}`;

      const payload = type === 'movie'
        ? { movies: [{ ids: { imdb: imdbIdWithPrefix } }] }
        : { shows: [{ ids: { imdb: imdbIdWithPrefix } }] };

      await this.apiRequest('/sync/ratings/remove', 'POST', payload);

      return true;
    } catch (error) {

      return false;
    }

1→# Specification: Complete Trakt Integration
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This task completes the Trakt.tv integration for Nuvio Streaming TV by wiring up the existing 90%-complete service layer to the UI, implementing bidirectional sync for watch progress, ratings, and collections, and adding visual status indicators throughout the application. The primary focus is resolving TODOs in AppleTVHero.tsx and implementing missing UI features to provide power users with seamless cross-device sync capabilities that differentiate Nuvio from competitors like Stremio (no native Trakt) and Kodi (no cloud sync).
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This task adds new user-facing functionality by completing an existing integration. It involves UI work, service method additions, and end-to-end feature implementation across multiple components, making it a classic feature workflow rather than refactoring, migration, or investigation.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - React Native TypeScript application containing all Trakt integration code
    17→
    18→### This Task Will:
    19→- [x] Fix watchlist status check placeholder in AppleTVHero.tsx (line 571)
    20→- [x] Enable watchlist add/remove functionality in AppleTVHero.tsx (line 610)
    21→- [x] Implement rating methods (add/update/remove) in traktService.ts
    22→- [x] Add rating UI component to media detail screens (1-10 scale)
    23→- [x] Add watchlist/collection status badges to content cards throughout UI
    24→- [x] Verify watch progress sync meets <30-second performance requirement
    25→- [x] Document Trakt API patterns and data flow for future maintenance
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Backend Trakt API development (service layer already complete)
    29→- New Trakt API endpoints beyond watchlist, ratings, collections, and scrobbling
    30→- Trakt social features (comments, lists, recommendations)
    31→- Trakt authentication flow changes (OAuth already implemented)
    32→- Performance optimization beyond meeting the 30-second sync requirement
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### main
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: TypeScript
    40→- Framework: React (React Native with Expo)
    41→- Package Manager: npm
    42→- Key Dependencies: react-native-mmkv (storage), expo-auth-session (OAuth)
    43→- Key Directories:
    44→  - `src/` - Source code
    45→  - `app/` - Application code
    46→  - `components/` - UI components
    47→
    48→**Entry Point:** `index.ts`
    49→
    50→**How to Run:**
    51→```bash
    52→npm run start
    53→```
    54→
    55→**Port:** 3000
    56→
    57→**Environment Variables Required:**
    58→- `EXPO_PUBLIC_TRAKT_CLIENT_ID` - Trakt API client ID (configured: `1e5e9e33d5a448188d269f1e8a06a213212bf9e5c0dd46c9641fc21d7b9ec1d5`)
    59→- `EXPO_PUBLIC_TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET` - Trakt API client secret (sensitive, already configured)
    60→- `EXPO_PUBLIC_TRAKT_REDIRECT_URI` - OAuth redirect URI (configured: `nuvio-tv://auth/trakt`)
    61→
    62→## Files to Modify
    63→
    64→| File | Service | What to Change |
    65→|------|---------|---------------|
    66→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` (line 571) | main | Replace `Math.random() > 0.5` placeholder with `traktService.isInWatchlist(imdbId, type)` |
    67→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` (line 610) | main | Uncomment and wire up `addToWatchlist()` / `removeFromWatchlist()` methods |
    68→| `src/services/traktService.ts` | main | Add rating methods: `addRating()`, `updateRating()`, `removeRating()` (currently only GET exists) |
    69→| `components/ContentItem.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add watchlist/collection status badge indicators |
    70→| `components/HeroSection.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add watchlist/collection status badge indicators |
    71→| `app/screens/MediaDetailScreen.tsx` (TBD) | main | Add rating UI component (1-10 scale with star display) |
    72→
    73→## Files to Reference
    74→
    75→These files show patterns to follow:
    76→
    77→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    78→|------|----------------|
    79→| `src/services/traktService.ts` | Trakt API call patterns, rate limiting queue, token management, error handling |
    80→| `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx` | Cached data access pattern for watchlist/collection lookups |
    81→| `app/screens/AppleTVHero.tsx` | Existing Trakt integration points (TODOs mark incomplete areas) |
    82→
    83→## Patterns to Follow
    84→
    85→### Trakt API Service Pattern
    86→
    87→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
    88→
    89→**Key Points:**
    90→- Singleton pattern: Always use `traktService.getInstance()` for service access
    91→- Native fetch API (no external HTTP libraries)
    92→- Rate limiting: 500ms minimum between requests via internal queue
    93→- Token auto-refresh: Handles expired tokens transparently
    94→- Error handling: Returns structured error objects with status codes
    95→- IMDb ID format: Always include 'tt' prefix (e.g., 'tt1234567')
    96→- Content types: Use 'movie' | 'show' | 'episode' exactly as defined
    97→
    98→**Example API Call Pattern:**
    99→```typescript
   100→async addToWatchlist(items: TraktSyncItem[]): Promise<TraktSyncResponse> {
   101→  return this.makeRequest('/sync/watchlist', {
   102→    method: 'POST',
   103→    body: JSON.stringify({ movies: items.filter(i => i.type === 'movie'), shows: items.filter(i => i.type === 'show') })
   104→  });
   105→}
   106→```
   107→
   108→### Cached Data Access Pattern
   109→
   110→From `src/contexts/TraktContext.tsx`:
   111→
   112→**Key Points:**
   113→- Use context for read-heavy operations (status checks)
   114→- Direct service calls for write operations (add/remove/rate)
   115→- Optimistic UI updates: Update UI immediately, sync in background
   116→- Context provides: `isInWatchlist()`, `isInCollection()`, `watchlist`, `collections`, `ratings`
   117→
   118→**Example Usage:**
   119→```typescript
   120→const { isInWatchlist, addToWatchlist } = useTraktContext();
   121→
   122→// Fast cached lookup
   123→const inWatchlist = isInWatchlist(imdbId, 'movie');
   124→
   125→// Write operation with optimistic update
   126→const handleAddToWatchlist = async () => {
   127→  setOptimisticState(true); // Update UI immediately
   128→  await traktService.addToWatchlist([{ type: 'movie', ids: { imdb: imdbId } }]);
   129→  // Context will refresh automatically
   130→};
   131→```
   132→
   133→### Scrobble Pattern (Already Working)
   134→
   135→From `src/services/traktService.ts`:
   136→
   137→**Key Points:**
   138→- Scrobble on playback start: `startWatching(content, progress)`
   139→- Progress updates every 5 seconds (debounced)
   140→- Pause handling: `pauseWatching()` if progress <80%
   141→- Complete handling: `stopWatching()` if progress ≥80%
   142→- 46-minute duplicate prevention window
   143→
   144→**Note**: This pattern is already functional - watch progress sync meets the <30-second requirement.
   145→
   146→## Requirements
   147→
   148→### Functional Requirements
   149→
   150→1. **Watchlist Status Indicators**
   151→   - Description: Display visual badges on all content cards and detail pages showing if item is in user's Trakt watchlist or collections
   152→   - Acceptance: User can see at a glance which content is already tracked without opening detail pages
   153→
   154→2. **Watchlist Management**
   155→   - Description: Add/remove content from Trakt watchlist directly within Nuvio UI
   156→   - Acceptance: Buttons/icons on content cards and detail pages trigger immediate Trakt sync with optimistic UI updates
   157→
   158→3. **Rating System**
   159→   - Description: Allow users to rate content (1-10 scale) from media detail screens with ratings syncing to Trakt profile
   160→   - Acceptance: Rating UI appears on detail screens, accepts 1-10 input, displays current rating if exists, syncs to Trakt API
   161→
   162→4. **Watch Progress Sync**
   163→   - Description: Automatically sync playback progress to Trakt during video playback
   164→   - Acceptance: Progress updates reach Trakt within 30 seconds of playback events (start/pause/stop), viewable on Trakt.tv
   165→
   166→5. **Collection Sync**
   167→   - Description: Bidirectional sync of user's Trakt collections
   168→   - Acceptance: Collections from Trakt appear in Nuvio, items added to collections in Nuvio appear on Trakt.tv
   169→
   170→6. **Code Cleanup**
   171→   - Description: Resolve all TODO comments in AppleTVHero.tsx related to Trakt integration
   172→   - Acceptance: No Trakt-related TODO comments remain in AppleTVHero.tsx, placeholder code replaced with functional implementations
   173→
   174→### Edge Cases
   175→
   176→1. **Offline Mode** - Gracefully handle missing network connection; queue Trakt actions and sync when connectivity returns
   177→2. **Token Expiration** - Service automatically refreshes expired tokens; user should never see auth errors during normal usage
   178→3. **Rate Limit Handling** - Respect Trakt API rate limits via internal queue (500ms between requests); prevent 429 errors
   179→4. **Missing IMDb IDs** - Some content may lack IMDb metadata; disable Trakt features gracefully for such items
   180→5. **Episode vs Show Context** - Ensure episode scrobbling correctly links to show in Trakt (requires show IMDb ID + season/episode numbers)
   181→6. **Duplicate Actions** - Prevent double-adding to watchlist or duplicate scrobbles via 46-minute deduplication window
   182→7. **Progress Threshold Edge** - Handle edge case where progress is exactly 80% (should mark as watched per Trakt convention)
   183→
   184→## Implementation Notes
   185→
   186→### DO
   187→- Use `TraktContext.isInWatchlist()` for all read-heavy status checks (faster due to caching)
   188→- Call `traktService` methods directly for write operations (add/remove/rate)
   189→- Implement optimistic UI updates for better perceived performance
   190→- Reuse existing rate limiting queue in traktService - don't create new HTTP clients
